<div class="stretch-widget">
  <svg
    class="stretch-svg"
    viewBox="0 0 866 631"
    preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"
    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    role="img"
    aria-label="Estiramiento Principal Lavadora Línea 2"
  >
    <defs>
      <!-- Contornos originales con esquinas redondeadas -->
      <clipPath
        id="stretch2-tank-top-clip"
        clipPathUnits="userSpaceOnUse"
      >
        <rect
          x="49"
          y="78"
          width="807"
          height="37"
          rx="6"
          ry="6"
        />
      </clipPath>

      <clipPath
        id="stretch2-tank-middle-clip"
        clipPathUnits="userSpaceOnUse"
      >
        <rect
          x="5"
          y="211"
          width="851"
          height="36"
          rx="6"
          ry="6"
        />
      </clipPath>

      <clipPath
        id="stretch2-tank-bottom-clip"
        clipPathUnits="userSpaceOnUse"
      >
        <rect
          x="5"
          y="343"
          width="851"
          height="38"
          rx="6"
          ry="6"
        />
      </clipPath>

      <!-- POLEAS: mismo metal satinado del widget anterior -->
      <linearGradient
        id="stretch2-roller-metal"
        x1="15%"
        y1="0%"
        x2="85%"
        y2="100%"
      >
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#EFF0F2" />
        <stop offset="24%" stop-color="#E2E3E6" />
        <stop offset="43%" class="roller-metal-base" />
        <stop offset="56%" stop-color="#E7E8EA" />
        <stop offset="74%" class="roller-metal-base" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#C3C5CA" />
      </linearGradient>

      <!-- CUBAS: reflejo metálico suave -->
      <linearGradient
        id="stretch2-tank-metal"
        x1="0%"
        y1="0%"
        x2="0%"
        y2="100%"
      >
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ECEEF0" />
        <stop offset="16%" stop-color="#E2E4E7" />
        <stop offset="46%" class="tank-metal-base" />
        <stop offset="62%" stop-color="#E2E3E6" />
        <stop offset="84%" class="tank-metal-base" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#C6C8CD" />
      </linearGradient>

      <!-- Franjas azules -->
      <linearGradient
        id="stretch2-liquid-gradient"
        x1="0%"
        y1="0%"
        x2="0%"
        y2="100%"
      >
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#B3D9EE" />
        <stop offset="40%" class="tank-liquid-base" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#96C5E1" />
      </linearGradient>

      <!-- POLEAS: sombra ambiental y sombra de contacto -->
      <filter
        id="stretch2-roller-shadow"
        x="-30%"
        y="-30%"
        width="160%"
        height="175%"
        color-interpolation-filters="sRGB"
      >
        <feGaussianBlur
          in="SourceAlpha"
          stdDeviation="1.5"
          result="rollerAmbientBlur"
        />
        <feOffset
          in="rollerAmbientBlur"
          dx="0.3"
          dy="2"
          result="rollerAmbientOffset"
        />
        <feFlood
          flood-color="#18212D"
          flood-opacity="0.12"
          result="rollerAmbientColor"
        />
        <feComposite
          in="rollerAmbientColor"
          in2="rollerAmbientOffset"
          operator="in"
          result="rollerAmbientShadow"
        />

        <feGaussianBlur
          in="SourceAlpha"
          stdDeviation="0.4"
          result="rollerContactBlur"
        />
        <feOffset
          in="rollerContactBlur"
          dx="0"
          dy="0.65"
          result="rollerContactOffset"
        />
        <feFlood
          flood-color="#111820"
          flood-opacity="0.17"
          result="rollerContactColor"
        />
        <feComposite
          in="rollerContactColor"
          in2="rollerContactOffset"
          operator="in"
          result="rollerContactShadow"
        />

        <feMerge>
          <feMergeNode in="rollerAmbientShadow" />
          <feMergeNode in="rollerContactShadow" />
          <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic" />
        </feMerge>
      </filter>

      <!-- CUBAS: sombra ambiental y sombra de contacto -->
      <filter
        id="stretch2-tank-shadow"
        x="-3%"
        y="-35%"
        width="106%"
        height="185%"
        color-interpolation-filters="sRGB"
      >
        <feGaussianBlur
          in="SourceAlpha"
          stdDeviation="2"
          result="tankAmbientBlur"
        />
        <feOffset
          in="tankAmbientBlur"
          dx="0"
          dy="2.5"
          result="tankAmbientOffset"
        />
        <feFlood
          flood-color="#18212D"
          flood-opacity="0.10"
          result="tankAmbientColor"
        />
        <feComposite
          in="tankAmbientColor"
          in2="tankAmbientOffset"
          operator="in"
          result="tankAmbientShadow"
        />

        <feGaussianBlur
          in="SourceAlpha"
          stdDeviation="0.5"
          result="tankContactBlur"
        />
        <feOffset
          in="tankContactBlur"
          dx="0"
          dy="0.8"
          result="tankContactOffset"
        />
        <feFlood
          flood-color="#111820"
          flood-opacity="0.15"
          result="tankContactColor"
        />
        <feComposite
          in="tankContactColor"
          in2="tankContactOffset"
          operator="in"
          result="tankContactShadow"
        />

        <feMerge>
          <feMergeNode in="tankAmbientShadow" />
          <feMergeNode in="tankContactShadow" />
          <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic" />
        </feMerge>
      </filter>

      <!-- Sombra interior discreta de las franjas azules -->
      <filter
        id="stretch2-liquid-inset"
        x="-2%"
        y="-20%"
        width="104%"
        height="140%"
        color-interpolation-filters="sRGB"
      >
        <feGaussianBlur
          in="SourceAlpha"
          stdDeviation="0.7"
          result="liquidBlur"
        />
        <feOffset
          in="liquidBlur"
          dx="0"
          dy="0.8"
          result="liquidOffset"
        />
        <feComposite
          in="SourceAlpha"
          in2="liquidOffset"
          operator="out"
          result="liquidInnerEdge"
        />
        <feFlood
          flood-color="#315F79"
          flood-opacity="0.16"
          result="liquidShadowColor"
        />
        <feComposite
          in="liquidShadowColor"
          in2="liquidInnerEdge"
          operator="in"
          result="liquidInnerShadow"
        />

        <feMerge>
          <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic" />
          <feMergeNode in="liquidInnerShadow" />
        </feMerge>
      </filter>
    </defs>

    <!--
      CUBAS

      Posiciones y dimensiones exteriores originales.
      Las franjas azules comienzan en la mitad de cada cuba.
      Margen lateral e inferior: 4 unidades SVG.
      Las cuerdas y poleas se dibujan posteriormente, por delante.
    -->
    <g class="tanks">

      <!-- Cuba superior: 807 × 37 -->
      <g class="tank-group">
        <g clip-path="url(#stretch2-tank-top-clip)">
          <rect
            class="tank-upper"
            x="49"
            y="78"
            width="807"
            height="37"
          />

          <rect
            class="tank-lower"
            x="53"
            y="96.5"
            width="799"
            height="14.5"
            rx="3"
            ry="3"
          />

          <path
            class="tank-top-highlight"
            d="M 56 79.2 L 849 79.2"
          />

          <path
            class="tank-bottom-shade"
            d="M 56 113.8 L 849 113.8"
          />
        </g>

        <rect
          class="tank-outline"
          x="49"
          y="78"
          width="807"
          height="37"
          rx="6"
          ry="6"
        />
      </g>

      <!-- Cuba intermedia: 851 × 36 -->
      <g class="tank-group">
        <g clip-path="url(#stretch2-tank-middle-clip)">
          <rect
            class="tank-upper"
            x="5"
            y="211"
            width="851"
            height="36"
          />

          <rect
            class="tank-lower"
            x="9"
            y="229"
            width="843"
            height="14"
            rx="3"
            ry="3"
          />

          <path
            class="tank-top-highlight"
            d="M 12 212.2 L 849 212.2"
          />

          <path
            class="tank-bottom-shade"
            d="M 12 245.8 L 849 245.8"
          />
        </g>

        <rect
          class="tank-outline"
          x="5"
          y="211"
          width="851"
          height="36"
          rx="6"
          ry="6"
        />
      </g>

      <!-- Cuba inferior: 851 × 38 -->
      <g class="tank-group">
        <g clip-path="url(#stretch2-tank-bottom-clip)">
          <rect
            class="tank-upper"
            x="5"
            y="343"
            width="851"
            height="38"
          />

          <rect
            class="tank-lower"
            x="9"
            y="362"
            width="843"
            height="15"
            rx="3"
            ry="3"
          />

          <path
            class="tank-top-highlight"
            d="M 12 344.2 L 849 344.2"
          />

          <path
            class="tank-bottom-shade"
            d="M 12 379.8 L 849 379.8"

        <rect

    <!-- CONDENSADO: recorridos originales -->

    <!--
      VAPOR

      Las tuberías se interrumpen en los cuerpos de las válvulas.

    -->

      <path

        d="M 252 540 L 252 164"

      <path

      <path

      <path

      <path

          L 367 367
          L 367 381

      />

      <!-- Colector principal -->
      <path
        class="steam-line steam-main"
        d="M 6 540 L 838 540"

    <!-- CONTROL: coordenadas originales -->
    <g class="control-system">
      <!-- Superior izquierda -->
      <path

    <!--
      VÁLVULAS

      Actuadores ovalados: rx=1.5, ry=6.5.

      <!-- Inferior -->

      >

    </g>

    <!-- CUERDA SUPERIOR: recorrido original íntegro -->

        class="fiber"

    <!--
      POLEAS

    <!-- NUMERACIÓN: negra, centrada y de 13 px -->
